Docket 1.3.122

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A Wix site is no longer told nothing about its visitors is recorded.* A site built on Wix with no Google Analytics
  or similar tag was told, at high severity, that no visitor numbers or traffic sources were being recorded. Wix
  records visitors, sessions and where they came from in the site's own dashboard. Docket now says no third-party
  tag was found and that Wix records visits itself.
- *"Request an Appointment" and a tap-to-call link count as calls to action.* A veterinary hospital's homepage with
  both was told no link on it asked the visitor to do anything. Docket now reads "request an", "book an", "make an
  appointment" and "call us" as actions, and any phone or text link is one whatever it says.
- *A logo in the main heading is no longer taken for the page's headline.* The same homepage's first main heading
  holds only its logo, so Docket read the phone line beneath it as the headline and said the page did not state what
  the business does. The headline is now the first main heading with words in it.
- *An image's file name in a logo's alt text is not a second brand name.* Website builders often fill in the alt
  text with the file name, such as "bluesky.jpeg". Docket counted that as another spelling of the business name. It
  now says the alt text does not name the business, which is the real fix.

99 checks across 13 areas.
